newsitem.title: UK: UBS sets call, put warrants on government bonds.
newsitem.headline: UBS sets call, put warrants on government bonds.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland said it has issued a total of four million American-style call and put warrants, in two equal tranches each on government bonds.

There are warrants on the 4.50 percent Swiss government bond due July 8, 2002, the 4.50 percent Swiss government bond due June 10, 2007, the 6.50 percent U.S. Treasury bond due November 15, 2026, the 6.0 percent German bund due January 4, 2007 and the 9.50 percent Italian BTP due February 1, 2006.
Maturity date for the warrants is December 22, 1997 and payement date is February 17, 1997. They are all listed on the Swiss exchange and available in exercise lots of 10,000.
